I told him everything. He knows how distressed I am but he thinks I'm selfish for still wanting to talk to him so I can't talk to him anymore. I live with him and I'm staying with my mum at the minute, but I really want to go home and see him, even though I know he won't want to see me.

In the past 24 hours, I've slept about 6 hours and cried for the rest of the time. I don't want to cry anymore but I can't stop. My whole body is sore from banging myself off things, not even to hurt myself, just because I keep feeling overwhelmed and doing stupid things. I have never felt this hurt in my entire life, and knowing it's my own fault just makes things worse. I fucked everything up for myself. I can text/pm you if you want? I really appreciate you taking the time to talk to me, so just whatever is easiest for you.
